get.description: Returns the currently authenticated user with company information

Get the current user's shopping cart with all items. Items are grouped by supplier to show how checkout will split orders. If cart contains items from multiple suppliers, itemsBySupplier will contain multiple groups.

200.description: Cart retrieved successfully. Response includes items array (flat) and itemsBySupplier array (grouped by supplier)

itemsBySupplier.description: Items grouped by supplier (matches checkout behavior)

itemCount.description: Number of items from this supplier

delete.description: Remove all items from the shopping cart

post.description: Add a product to the shopping cart. The unit_price is automatically calculated using the product's pharmacist_price with any applicable discounts and offers applied. Offers are automatically detected and applied if the quantity meets the offer requirements.

product_id.description: Product ID to add to cart

200.description: Item added to cart successfully. Price uses product pharmacist_price with discounts and offers applied. If an offer is applied, appliedOfferId will be set.

403.description: Forbidden - Only buyers can add items to cart

put.description: Update quantity or notes of a cart item. Offers are automatically re-evaluated when quantity changes.

delete.description: Remove an item from the shopping cart

get.summary: Get available offers for cart item
get.description: Get all available offers for a cart item based on current quantity. Returns all applicable offers with pricing details.

post.summary: Apply specific offer to cart item
post.description: Manually apply a specific offer to a cart item. This overrides the automatically selected best offer.

offer_id.description: ID of the offer to apply

404.description: Cart item or offer not found

400.description: Offer cannot be applied (quantity requirement not met, etc.)

post.summary: Remove applied offer from cart item
post.description: Remove the manually applied offer and revert to automatically selected best offer (or base price if no offers available).

Convert cart items to orders. If cart contains items from multiple suppliers, multiple orders will be created automatically (one per supplier). All orders are created in a single atomic transaction - either all succeed or all fail. Cart is cleared after successful checkout.

200.description: Orders created successfully. Returns array of orders if multiple suppliers, single order if one supplier.

message.example: Cart checked out. Multiple orders created for different suppliers.

items.description: Order object with buyerCompany, supplierCompany, and items.product relationships

post.summary: Checkout cart items for specific supplier
post.description: Convert cart items from a specific supplier to an order. Only items from the specified supplier will be checked out. Other items remain in the cart. Cart totals are recalculated after checkout.

200.description: Order created successfully for the specified supplier.

order.description: Order object with buyerCompany, supplierCompany, and items.product relationships

items_checked_out.description: Number of cart items checked out

items_remaining.description: Number of items remaining in cart

400.description: Cart is empty or no items found for supplier

get.description: Get a paginated list of orders filtered by user's company. **Multi-supplier context:** Buyers see all their orders (potentially from multiple suppliers - one order per supplier). Suppliers see all orders placed with them (from multiple buyers). Each order represents a single supplier-buyer transaction. When a cart contains items from multiple suppliers and is checked out, multiple orders are created automatically (one per supplier).

parameters.name: status
parameters.description: Filter orders by status

parameters.name: supplier_company_id
parameters.description: Filter by supplier company ID (for buyers)

parameters.name: buyer_company_id
parameters.description: Filter by buyer company ID (for suppliers)

parameters.name: from_date
parameters.description: Filter orders created from this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: to_date
parameters.description: Filter orders created up to this date (YYYY-MM-DD)

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Items per page. Use "all" for no pagination.

parameters.name: paginate
parameters.description: Use "false" to get all results without pagination

200.description: Orders retrieved successfully. Each order includes buyerCompany, supplierCompany, items, and items.product relationships. Orders are grouped by supplier - if a buyer purchased from 3 suppliers, they will see 3 separate orders.

items.description: Order object with buyerCompany, supplierCompany, items.product relationships

post.description: Create a new order for a **single supplier**. Only buyers can create orders. If unit_price is not provided, it will use the product's pharmacist_price with any applicable discounts applied (getFinalPharmacistPrice method). **Important:** This endpoint creates ONE order for ONE supplier. If you need to order from multiple suppliers, use the cart checkout endpoint (`POST /cart/checkout`) which automatically splits the cart into multiple orders (one per supplier).

supplier_company_id.description: Supplier company ID - all items must belong to this supplier

items.description: Array of order items. All products must belong to the specified supplier_company_id

unit_price.description: Optional - will use product pharmacist_price with discounts applied (getFinalPharmacistPrice) if not provided

201.description: Order created successfully. Returns a single order object. For multi-supplier orders, use cart checkout which returns an array of orders.

order.description: Single order object with buyerCompany, supplierCompany, and items.product relationships

403.description: Forbidden - Only buyers can create orders

422.description: Validation error - products must belong to the specified supplier

get.description: Get details of a specific order. **Multi-supplier context:** Each order represents a transaction between ONE buyer and ONE supplier. If a buyer checked out a cart with items from multiple suppliers, they will have multiple separate orders (one per supplier). This endpoint returns details for a single order, including buyerCompany, supplierCompany, creator, items.product, statusLogs.user, and driver (if assigned).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Order ID

200.description: Order retrieved successfully. Includes all relationships and driver information if assigned. The order represents a single supplier-buyer transaction.

order.description: Order object with buyerCompany (buyer info), supplierCompany (supplier info), creator, items.product, statusLogs.user, and driver relationships

403.description: Forbidden - User can only view orders from their own company

post.description: Transition order to a new status. Valid transitions are enforced. **Multi-supplier context:** Each order is managed independently. If a buyer has multiple orders from different suppliers, each order's status must be updated separately. Suppliers can update status for orders placed with them, buyers can view status updates.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Order ID

status.description: New order status. Must be a valid transition from current status.

notes.description: Optional notes about the status change

200.description: Order status updated successfully. Returns updated order with buyerCompany, supplierCompany, and items.product relationships.

400.description: Invalid status transition - cannot transition from current status to requested status

403.description: Forbidden - Suppliers can only update their own orders

post.description: Cancel an order. Requires cancellation reason. **Multi-supplier context:** Each order can be cancelled independently. If a buyer has multiple orders from different suppliers and wants to cancel all, each order must be cancelled separately. Stock is automatically reverted when an order is cancelled.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Order ID

200.description: Order cancelled successfully. Stock has been automatically reverted. Returns updated order with cancellation_reason.

order.description: Cancelled order object with status set to cancelled and cancellation_reason populated

400.description: Cannot cancel order in current status - order may already be delivered or cancelled

403.description: Forbidden - Buyers can cancel their own orders, suppliers can cancel orders placed with them
